look_mechanics:
# Nine-tailed Fox look mechanics

The supplied white-and-pink fox has a separate flexible neck and a large expressive face. Keep seated haunches, front paws, chest pendant attachment, and broad nine-tail fan anchored. The neck and head lead attention with physical eyeball rotation inside the original almond eyelid apertures. Violet irises, dark pupils, sclera, lashes, eyelids and highlights move together; never add replacement eyes. Ears and cheek fur follow the head subtly. The pendant stays on the chest and changes occlusion only naturally under the chin, never swaps crescent or flower sides.

000 up: lift muzzle/chin and extend the neck slightly, pupils and eye globes aim upward, lower muzzle underside more visible, ears follow back slightly. Must clearly look above viewer, not neutral.
090 screen-right: turn head to image right; nose is clearly right of head center, face surface and eye sockets turn right, far cheek and far eye narrow naturally. Torso remains seated and anchored.
180 down: tuck chin toward chest, nose points down toward forepaws, eyelids lower over downward-aimed violet eyes and more crown/forehead becomes visible. Must clearly look below viewer, not sleepy neutral.
270 screen-left: turn head to image left; nose clearly left of head center, face surface and eye sockets turn left, opposite cheek and eye become foreshortened. Never use the rightward default pose for this cardinal.

Each 22.5-degree step should interpolate head yaw and pitch evenly along a smooth circular attention path, with roughly equal facial landmark displacement per step. At near-vertical diagonals, retain visible horizontal head/eye turn; at near-horizontal diagonals, retain visible up/down pitch. Row 9 moves up through up-right to right and down-right. Row 10 moves down through down-left to left and up-left. 157.5 to 180 and 337.5 to 000 are ordinary single steps, with no tail-fan flips, body translations, head-scale changes, or pendant jumps.

Small-size priorities: preserve the large original violet almond eyes and smiling tiny muzzle, upright ears, white/pink materials, visible gold crescent pendant, compact full body and recognizable nine-tail fan. Simplify individual fur strands and tiny flower petals. Tail lobes may overlap naturally but cannot cover the face. No whole-sprite rotation, skew, arbitrary warping, new props, particles, shadows, glow or detached marks.
